declarations.docstring: Rational algebraicity of complex numbers is preserved by addition and multiplication, and by inversion of a nonzero number.
The complex subtype underlying the distinguished rational intermediate field is algebraically closed.
The distinguished rational intermediate field in the complex numbers is an algebraic closure of the rationals.
Every element of the distinguished rational intermediate field in the complex numbers is algebraic over the rationals.
Integral complex numbers over the integers are closed under addition and multiplication.
A distinguished integer subalgebra of the complex numbers.
A distinguished rational intermediate field in the complex numbers.
Membership in the distinguished integer subalgebra is equivalent to integrality over the integers.
Membership in the distinguished rational intermediate field is equivalent to algebraicity over the rationals.
